0022600024.text: The Suns host the Nuggets in their fourth game of the 2026-27 season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup, with Phoenix at 1-2 (1-0 at home, 0-2 on the road) and on a one-game losing streak, sitting 11th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 2 games back. Mark Williams is out after shoulder surgery, and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and a game-time decision. Denver is also 1-2, 10th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 2.5 games back, on a one-game losing streak, and is missing Alpha Diallo (personal), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, while in 2025-26 the Suns lost 0-3, and their last meeting was a 125-123 Suns loss in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.
